task.name: Assemble_Buffer_Bush
task.when: During Build after the Buffer Bush footprint is approved

step.action: Confirm the Buffer Bush drawing, part count, electrical plan, anchor plan, and final-state photograph in 📦 Build_Book.
Mark the footprint and walking paths from 📦 Camp_Map.
Count and inspect the base, anchors, buffers, pads, covers, lighting, cables, and controls.
Assemble and anchor the base in the printed sequence.
Install the buffers, inflated pads, fur covers, and tentacle covers in their numbered positions.
Have the Power Lead inspect, route, and connect every de-energized cable and control.

passWhen.criterion: The Buffer Bush matches the current drawing and final-state photograph.
Every listed part and anchor is installed and every path is clear.
The Power Lead approved the electrical installation.
